look.summary_zh: 冷色 · 压暗中灰 · 中段跨度接近原值
look.description_zh: 50% 灰输出 Y′ 115.3/255（变化 -12.2 码值）；25%–75% 灰跨度比 1.026。中灰红减蓝 -43.9 码值。浅/中/深肤色色块分别输出 #F3D6C5、#CA9079、#7D4B3A；红/绿/蓝测试块分别输出 #CC2D37、#23BC28、#0032D4。
look.description_en: 50% gray Y′ 115.3/255 (-12.2 code values); 25–75% gray span ratio 1.026; mid-gray red minus blue -43.9 code values. Light/medium/deep skin swatches: #F3D6C5, #CA9079, #7D4B3A. Red/green/blue swatches: #CC2D37, #23BC28, #0032D4.
look.suggested_use_zh: 冷色城市、夜景与科技试片
look.suggested_use_en: Compare on your own SDR product, portrait and landscape footage before selecting.
look.cautions_zh: 逐项比较肤色与品牌色，强度过高可能改变产品颜色。仅像素颜色映射，不生成颗粒、光晕、暗角、空间雾或美颜；未做自然画质验收。
look.cautions_en: Pixel color mapping only; no grain, glow, vignette, spatial haze or beauty effects. Natural footage quality is unaccepted. Check skin/product colors and clipped output.
